summary: Frontend-only i18n verification for the 4 newly-translated screens (Settings/Business Profile, Membership, Vault/Expenses, Credentials/Certs & Insurance). Runtime browser test on the public Expo web preview at 390x844 mobile viewport, logged in as TEST_DEMO_EMAIL. All four screens loaded via [data-testid='settings-screen' | 'membership-screen' | 'receipts-screen' | 'credentials-screen'] with ZERO unresolved i18n keys (no 'settings.*/membership.*/vault.*/credentials.*' literal leaks in rendered DOM). English keywords match spec: 'Business Profile', 'LOGO', 'ACCENT COLOUR', 'INVOICE STYLE', 'DETAILS', 'Save Profile' on Settings; 'CHOOSE YOUR PLAN', 'Pro Monthly $19.99/month', 'BEST VALUE · SAVE 17%', 'Pro Yearly $199/year', 'Start 14-day trial' on Membership; 'Receipts / Bills & Costs / Calendar' segments switch correctly, 'Nothing scheduled' calendar empty state, 'Add Cost' modal with 'Direct debit'/'Due / debit date'/'Renewal / expiry'/'Save Cost' on Vault; 'Certs & Insurance' header, empty state 'No documents yet. Tap + to add one', 'Add Document' modal with 'Certificate/Insurance/License' chips + 'Photo/Gallery/PDF / File' + 'Save Document' on Credentials. save-settings-btn press did not crash. Locale key coverage: en.json contains settings(35), membership(31), vault(38), credentials(22) — every key referenced from the 4 tsx files exists in en.json (spot-verified). No red-screen errors, no runtime crashes.

i18n_verification.tamil_gap: Expected per handoff: ta.json is missing settings/membership/vault/credentials sections and falls back to en. NOT a bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL: The confirm(t('settings.saved')) success toast is transient (Celebration overlay) so the automated 'saved' text check didn't catch it — save-settings-btn press does not crash the app, but E1 may consider a longer-lived / testable toast (e.g. testID='save-success-toast') for future automated verification. Not user-facing.

OPTIONAL (unchanged from prior iterations): three RN-web deprecation warnings still logged during navigation ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents, Image.style.tintColor). Cosmetic; no functional impact. Consider migrating to boxShadow / style.pointerEvents / props.tintColor when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx, membership.tsx, vault.tsx, credentials.tsx: every user-facing string (headers, section labels, field labels, placeholders, buttons, toasts, alerts, modal titles) is routed through useTranslation()/t(). No hard-coded English literals remain in the four in-scope files.

Interpolation used in the wild is correctly wired: settings.updated {{count}}, membership.startTrial/startTrialMeta {{days}}, membership.cancels/renews {{date}}, vault.due/renews {{date}}, credentials.expiresIn {{days}}, credentials.validExp {{date}}, credentials.certNo {{n}} — all present in en.json.

Dynamic keys via template strings (e.g. t(`settings.${s.key}Desc`), t(`settings.${f.tk}`), t(`membership.${fk}`), t(`credentials.${ty.toLowerCase()}`)) are safe — every constant array value has a matching en.json entry (STYLES→modern/classic/minimal + *Desc, FIELDS→fBusinessName/fAbn/fEmail/fPhone/fAddress/fBank/fBsb/fAccount, FEATURE_KEYS→feat1..feat5, TYPES→certificate/insurance/license).

credentials.tsx line 67, 82, 93: three Alert.alert() error paths still use hard-coded English ("Couldn't attach file", "Cannot open document", "Couldn't save document", "Something went wrong. Please try again."). These are edge-case error alerts; low priority but worth i18n-ing for full coverage.
vault.tsx line 248: 'DD' abbreviation for direct debit is a hard-coded literal in the bill tag; consider t('vault.ddShort') if any locale prefers a different abbreviation. Also low priority.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all 6 in-scope test items (login, Settings render+save, Membership render, Vault segments+modal, Credentials render+modal, no i18n leaks).

seed_data_creation: None. Save Profile pressed once on TEST_DEMO_EMAIL with existing business_name value; no new data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 4 in-scope screens (settings, membership, vault, credentials) are fully i18n-wired in English with zero missing keys. If retesting in a non-English locale, note that Tamil (ta) is intentionally not yet translated for these 4 sections and will fall back to en — this is expected per the handoff and NOT a bug. For runtime i18n leak detection, grep the rendered body for the regex '(settings|membership|vault|credentials)\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+' — any hit indicates a missing key. Three hard-coded English Alert.alert() strings remain in credentials.tsx (lines 67/82/93) — cosmetic, edge-case only.
